name: PicS N.V.
summary: PicS N.V. operates as a digital financial services company that provides digital wallet and application for individuals and businesses in Brazil. The company offers a range of transactional products for its consumers, including Pix, an instant payment system, peer-to-peer between PicPay accounts, bill payments, payroll portability, global account, and a payment assistant that helps consumers organize, centralize, and settle bills through an integrated hub.
